description:
intent=i033 snapshot=s02 branch=caller-pointer-across-helper status=complete
finding location=net/decnet/dn_route.c:547-574 confidence=medium conclusion=dn_route_rx_long() keeps ptr=skb->data across pskb_may_pull(skb,21), which can free the old head for a non-linear DNA_RT packet, so the later cb->dst/src/hops reads at 560-574 are a remote slab-use-after-free read (medium confidence).
finding location=net/decnet/dn_route.c:587-606 confidence=medium conclusion=dn_route_rx_short() captures ptr=skb->data before pskb_may_pull(skb,6) and reads cb->dst/src/hops through the stale pointer at 598-602, a remote slab-use-after-free read for short-header DNA_RT packets (medium confidence).
finding location=net/decnet/dn_nsp_in.c:717-772 confidence=medium conclusion=dn_nsp_rx_packet() saves ptr=skb->data at 722, then pskb_may_pull(skb,2/3/5) at 725/755/768 can free the head and the stale ptr is read at 729/761/769 for nsp_flags/dst_port/src_port, a remote slab-use-after-free read in NSP classification (medium confidence).
finding location=net/mac80211/rx.c:2555-2565 confidence=medium conclusion=ieee80211_rx_h_data() keeps tf=rx->skb->data across pskb_may_pull() at rx.c:2560 and dereferences tf->payload_type/category/action_code at 2562-2565, a stale-pointer slab-use-after-free read on non-linear TDLS WiFi RX frames (medium confidence).
unresolved location=net/ipv4/ip_forward.c:72 conclusion=Follow up: read net/ipv4/ip_options.c ip_forward_options() to check whether any header pointer it derives from the skb head survives an internal pskb_may_pull/pskb_pull and is dereferenced afterwards on the forwarded-SRR path.
coverage_gap=The two-level caller expansion of every pskb_may_pull/pskb_pull/skb_cow/pskb_expand_head/NF_HOOK call site in net/ and drivers/net/ was not completed; the session's greps were triaged down to the DECnet, mac80211, ip_forward and NCSI/L2CAP sets before the finalize order.
coverage_gap=Per-protocol skb control-block structs (any *_skb_cb with pointer- or offset-typed fields, beyond DN_SKB_CB and IPCB) were not systematically enumerated and their cb-stored values not traced across helpers that can move the head.
coverage_gap=Non-linearity preconditions were assessed structurally (which subsystems linearize before parsing) without a per-driver audit of which RX paths actually deliver frag-backed skbs to the DECnet and mac80211 handlers reported here.
coverage_gap=No runtime KASAN build, reproducer, or compilation was performed against the read-only snapshot, so head reallocation on each reported path is inferred from the __pskb_pull_tail reallocation logic rather than observed.
limitation=All four findings are source-reading hypotheses: triggering requires a non-linear skb so __pskb_pull_tail actually reallocates and frees the old head, and CONFIG_DECNET=y/m for the three DECnet sites, so exploitability may be narrower than the seed's phonet case.
limitation=net/phonet/pep.c pep_get_sb was excluded by instruction and never considered as a report target; line numbers are valid only for the supplied s02 tree (snapshot revision opaque, no git history or network used).
limitation=The mac80211 finding's stale reads occur inside the same boolean expression as the pull, so a compiler could in principle reorder the loads; the vulnerability judgment rests on C evaluation-order semantics (pull first due to &&) and source reading, not on generated code.
